title: Banff Centre Mountain Film Festival
description: For 50 years, the Banff Tour has been showings the best adventure films of the Banff Centre Mountain Film Festival, which takes place annually in November in the small town of Banff in the Canadian Rocky Mountains. To make sure that outdoor film fans all over the world don’t miss out, a selection of the best films will go on a big world tour after the festival and will make it’s annual stop at the Regent Theatre. Come and Celebrate our 31st year hosting the show here in the greater Boston area! ALL SEATS: $34.00 MONDAY / WEDNESDAY PROGRAM — “MORAINE“ ﻿ Cold Calls: Japan Calling people might feel outdated these days, but if you’re a pro freerider and your phone rings, you probably shouldn’t let it go to voicemail. That call might just be someone offering you a spot in their next ski film—someone like Alexi Godbout. Lucky for Canadian freerider Alex Armstrong, she picked up. The result? An unforgettable ski trip to Japan—complete with sushi, late nights, and bottomless powder. _________________________________ The Hive Architect For the last 14 years Matt Somerville has spent the winters creating his log hives before driving around all of England in the summer, erecting them as non-intervention habitats for wild honey bees. _________________________________ Best Day Ever *2025 Best Film: Mountain Sports 2025 Audience Choice Award Best Day Ever follows the stories of adaptive mountain bikers Greg Durso and Allie Bianchi as they navigate the relentless challenges of their disabilities with humor and attitude. title: Divine Feminine By PRASHASTI SINGH Standup Comedy
description: Performance in Hindi Growing up in a patriarchal family, Prashasti naturally had only one dream – to become a patriarch herself. Inching towards 40, but pretending to be 30, Prashasti can finally mark this dream complete. But instead of happiness, she finds herself pondering if the ascent was even worth the price? In her brand new standup show, Prashasti questions all her life choices and meticulously assigns blame to the women and men who shaped her into this being. Prashasti Singh is a stand-up comic and writer from India. She can be seen on Netflix’s Ladies Up, Comedy Premium League and Amazon Prime Video’s Comicstaan. She has been touring internationally with her last show Man of the House. Her standup special Door Khadi Sharmaaye is available on YouTube.

title: Deepfaking Sam Altman
description: FEATURING LIVE Q&A WITH FILMMAKER ADAM BHALA LOUGH with Rich Hakim, Research Fellow at the Harvard Kempner Institute for AI When Los Angeles filmmaker Adam Bhala Lough fails to land an interview with the elusive Sam Altman, he travels to India to deepfake the tech CEO, only to create a glitchy LLM “Sam Bot” that moves into his home, befriends his son and begins co-directing the movie. As Sam Bot grows more lifelike, Adam is forced to decide whether to delete the AI he accidentally brought to life, and the film becomes a sharp, surprisingly moving exploration of how humans navigate the chaotic new world of artificial intelligence. ﻿ Film runtime: 1h36m Tickets: General Admission: $20 Seniors (62+): $18 Veterans: $15

title: Harsha
description: This film is in Nepali with English subtitles Bound by duty and pride, Keshar has lived his life by unbending rules of caste and culture. But when grief enters his home, the walls he built begin to crack. As his family drifts apart, Keshar must choose between the comfort of his past and the healing power of change.

title: The Jury Experience -- Diamonds, Lies, and a Dead Man in Boston!
description: ⭐ You’ve been called for jury duty. Step into a thrilling courtroom drama where the audience is the jury. Listen to testimonies, analyze evidence, and ultimately decide… guilty or not guilty? 🫣 Crime #1: Superstar Lana Tonneti’s $20m necklace is gone. Now her ex-driver’s on trial for the theft. But is there more to the story? Scandal brews as a disgraced ex-driver stands trial for stealing global superstar Lana Tonneti’s $20m necklace. But is Lana telling the truth? Throughout the show, analyze witness testimonies, examine the evidence, answer complex questions, and try to uncover what really happened. Every word matters. Every detail counts. And at the end, you must cast the vote that determines the fate of the accused. Will justice be served? Well, that’s up to you. Get your tickets now for The Jury Experience: Diamonds, Lies, and a Dead Man in Boston! Highlights 🤩 Enjoy a live theatre courtroom drama where you decide the final verdict 🫵 Make tough decisions throughout the show—your votes steer the story 🕵️‍♂️ Dissect witness testimonies, unpack evidence, and weigh every argument Duration: 60 minutes 👤 Age requirement: 12+. Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult https://regenttheatre.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/jury-necklace.webm TICKET PRICES $40 – $60 General Information and Policies

title: Billy Preston: That's the Way God Planned It
description: FEATURING AN OPENING LIVE PERFORMANCE OF BILLY PRESTON’S MUSIC BY LEON BEAL An exhilarating documentary about the legendary GRAMMY-winning musician whose signature sound shaped the work of The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, Ray Charles, Sly Stone, Aretha Franklin, and countless others. You will hear Preston’s, Nothing From Nothing, Will It Go ‘Round In Circles, That’s The Way God Planned It and You Are, So Beautiful all written by Billy Preston and sung by Leon Beal. Then, Athene Wilson, perhaps the finest female R&B, Jazz, Soul and Gospel vocalist in New England will join Beal to sing the duet that Billy Preston sang with Syreeta Wright and made famous (#2 in America) for Motown in 1979 …With You I’m Born Again ﻿ Billy Preston was 5 years old when he backed gospel legend Mahalia Jackson. Over the following six-decade career, Billy contributed his signature sound to the greatest artists of his time, including The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, Barbra Streisand, Sly Stone, Ray Charles, Rufus, Eric Clapton, and others, while establishing himself as a GRAMMY-winning solo artist. Despite his success, Billy struggled to reconcile his deep relationship with the Black church with his sexuality, setting off a lifelong quest to find love and acceptance Runtime: 1h 45m Tickets General Admission: $25 Seniors: $23 Veterans: $20

title: All the Women I Love: the music of Bonnie Raitt, Linda Ronstadt, and Emmylou Harris
description: This show has now become a March tradition at the Regent. Award-winning singer/songwriter Susan Cattaneo celebrates Women’s History month by paying image to the artists who influenced generations of other women to take center stage. This is not a traditional tribute band, focused on jukebox versions of the hits featuring the music of only one artist. It’s a musical love letter from one of Boston’s most respected singer/songwriters to the women who made her the artist she is today and an inside view of how their influence shaped her music. Susan is bringing an all-star band to the Regent featuring some of Boston’s most beloved musicians: Peter Moore on keys, Andy Santospago on guitar, Joe McMahon on bass and Chris Anzalone on drums. SEAT PRICES PREMIUM: $49 PREFERRED: $39 RESERVED: $29 ﻿ This is what the late, beloved and highly missed Steve Morse (former Boston Globe music critic) wrote after attending the show. “Sensational is barely the word to cover Susan Cattaneo’s show at the Regent Theatre last night. She called it a tribute to “All the Women I Love,” most notably Linda Ronstadt, Bonnie Raitt and Emmylou Harris. It was a labor of love — and an absolutely captivating trip through some of the most important song books of our times. Susan had the voice to invest nearly every tune with just the right color and spirit, while also touching upon classics by Carly Simon, Carole King, Joni Mitchell and Christine McVie. She was funny when need be, serious as well, and her Boston-based band was impeccable. This show is so good that it could tour theaters nationally, and I can hardly wait for Cattaneo to do it again.” Susan Cattaneo knows her way around a song and has been a staple of the Boston music scene, as a performer artist and sought after co-writer. Aside from releasing six albums of her own, her songs have been recorded by other artists regionally and nationally including local music heroes Dennis Brennan, Mark Erelli, Dinty Child, Jenee Halstead and Carla Ryder.

title: Nawi: Dear Future Me
description: A film that drives action Voice for Change Thirteen-year-old Nawi is being forced to marry a much older stranger in exchange for a herd of goats. Her story is about what happens when a girl decides not to follow the path chosen for her – and the cost of saying no. NAWI exposes the brutal impact of child marriages, how they cut short education and steal away futures. It’s not just a film – it’s a way to experience what this looks like, up close. And why we need to fight for change. NAWI is based on true events, on the winning story of a nationwide writing competition by Kenyan teen counsellor Milcah Cherotich. It has been selected as Kenya’s official Oscar entry 2025, won an Africa Academy Award as well as multiple other international awards, including at Raindance in London, at the Beijing International Film Festival and the LA-based Pan African Film Fest. In theatres Across North America on March 6 , 2026. ﻿ Film runtime: 1h43m Tickets General Admission: $20 Seniors (62+): $18 Veterans: $15

title: Paris Chansons
description: Paris Chansons returns to Boston with NEW songs and favorites from before! Featuring original renditions of classics by Charles Aznavour, Joe Dassin, Edith Piaf, Macias, Adamo, Dalida, Patricia Kaas, Vanessa Paradis, Brel, Zaz to Stromae PLUS some of the most beloved Italian, Hebrew and Russian gypsy classics! ﻿ Paris Chansons is an exciting French band with an Eastern European gypsy twist! They are known for their original renditions of French favorites from Aznavour, Dassin, Piaf, Macias, Adamo, Dalida, all the way to contemporary artists like Zaz. Their exhilarating performances are punctuated with gypsy jazz standards as well as classics in Russian, Italian, and other languages. Three multilingual singers bring an unparalleled diversity to their shows. Julia Kantor, originally from the Ukraine, lived and studied in France where she discovered in French music a soul connection that still imbues every performance. She entrances from the stage with a sultry voice and dynamic presence. Together with her husband, Jacob, a Russian-born singer/songwriter, they launched Paris Chansons. Max Cohen grew up in Morocco steeped in French music, particularly the songs of Enrico Macias. Max’s rich velvety tone delivers beautifully nuanced renditions of his favorites, complete with a signature North African lilt. Superb musicianship anchors the ensemble, effortlessly moving from jazzy improvisation to slow-burning balladry to blistering gypsy fervor. All seasoned pros, the musicians are Jeff Lams on piano, Adam Cohen on upright bass, Endre Balogh on violin, Sinclair Lott on drums and Jacob Kantor on guitar. Paris Chansons takes you an a journey without leaving your seat (except, of course, to dance!), a spectacular celebration of French and international music that brings the world that much closer.

title: Between Two Worlds
description: What became of the Lost Boys and Girls of Sudan? For the first time, we hear from their remarkable children in a film that celebrates courage, success, and hope. The South Sudanese Enrichment for Families invites you to experience a story of hope, resilience, and love that transcends borders. Join us for a special screening of Between Two Worlds An inspiring film that shares the voices of South Sudanese children shaped by the courage of their immigrant mothers. At a time when so many stories focus on crisis, this one reminds us of humanity’s quiet strength and the joy that comes from perseverance and connection. Come be moved, uplifted, and inspired to see the world and your own family’s story in a new light. Rediscover the power of a mother’s love. A short film followed by a panel discussion from South Sudanese community leaders: Panther Alier, Taban Manyok, Awan Awan, Bedphiny Deng, Nyandeng Yaak and Molly Bedell, Film Producer, formerly from Lincoln (Molly Robinson).

title: Mountains of the Moon
description: Acclaimed Singer-Songwriter-Guitarist, Scott Damgaard, will perform a short set of Grateful Dead tunes before the film Without darkness, we can’t see the light. In Mountains of the Moon, world renowned artist and skier, Chris Benchetler explores the unseen connections between sport, life, music, and the living earth—set to the timeless tunes of the Grateful Dead. Captured almost entirely at night using cutting-edge cinematography, lasers, animation, and projection mapping, the film leads viewers on a surreal journey through ocean, river, and mountain landscapes. The world’s greatest athletes, adventurers, and thinkers appear as luminous figures, navigating through the natural world. ﻿ TICKET PRICES General Admission: $20 Seniors (62+): $18 Veterans: $15 Patron- and Director-level Members: $15 Producer-level Members: FREE BECOME A MEMBER TODAY General Information and Policies

title: Dangerous Games
description: This is a Russian language event. The long-awaited premiere features beloved actors: Glafira Tarkhanova, Ilya Noskov, Elena Arosyeva, Sergey Peregudov, and Maxim Vazhov in the play “Dangerous Games” by the renowned director Oleg Topolyansky, based on a play by French playwrights J. Dell and J. Siblerays. An intriguing tragicomedy on the themes of loyalty and love, in the style of the once very popular play “Who’s Afraid of Virginia Woolf?”, which explores the complexities of marriage between a middle-aged couple. The exemplary couple Claire and Bruno have been living in peace and harmony for 12 years, the envy of everyone around them. One day, while hosting a gathering of relatives and friends at their country house, the couple decides to play a prank on their loved ones by telling them that they are getting a divorce. The provocative game completely changes the lives of the characters and leads to irreversible consequences. An innocent prank can turn into a catastrophe: jealous suspicions, absurd coincidences, and secret desires that suddenly have the opportunity to be fulfilled threaten to destroy everything. The performance captivates with its virtuoso acting, unexpected plot twists, subtle humor, and signature French charm. The cast: Glafira Tarkhanova, who served for many years at the Satyricon Theatre and is beloved by audiences for her roles in films such as “Demons,” “The Gromovs,” and “The Fall of the Empire,” also toured North America with the comedy “The Wheel of Fortune” alongside Maxim Vazhov. The brilliant Elena Arosyeva, known for her roles in the films “The Mockingbird’s Smile,” “Two Shores,” “The Stranger,” “Birth Certificate,” “Zero Kilometer,” “While the Fern Blooms,” and others. Ilya Noskov is the most famous Fandorin, known for the film “Azazel,” as well as “Moscow Saga,” “Kamenskaya,” “The Great,” and many others. Sergey Peregudov is an actor known for the films “Adjutants of Love,” “Gromovs,” “Kamenskaya,” and “Shalyapin.”

Warm yourself with the sounds and memories of Aretha Franklin’s legacy on the first weekend of spring as The Master Entertainer, Leon Beal, brings back a bevy of multi-talented musicians and vocalists (Angelena Hightower, Athene Wilson & Darlene Wynn) to the Regent Theatre. This reprise engagement of their one-of-a-kind tribute will lift your spirits and turn the venue into a Sing Along Night of song, dance and celebration in Arlington’s Showplace of Entertainment. title: A Man Called Hurt: The Life and Music of Mississippi John Hurt
description: INCLUDING LIVE PERFORMANCES BY MUSICIANS FEATURED IN THE FILM!! A Man Called Hurt chronicles the life and influence of Mississippi John Hurt on the music world. In anticipation of Mississippi John Hurt’s March 24th induction into the Folk Americana Roots Hall of Fame, the Regent Theatre will host a fundraising event for the Mississippi John Hurt Foundation (MJHF), featuring an esteemed list of folk musicians performing live music prior to a screening of the award-winning documentary, A Man Called Hurt: The Life and Music of Mississippi John Hurt. Confirmed participating concert musicians include John Sebastian, Rory Block, Guy Davis, Andy Cohen, Downtown Charlie Brown, Piedmont Bluz Acoustic Duo, Eleanor Ellis, and Craig Sonnenfeld. This will be the very first screening of A Man Called Hurt: The Life and Music of Mississippi John Hurt in the Northeast US. Featuring interviews from Mary Frances Hurt, John Sebastian of The Loving Spoonful, Happy Traum, Guy Davis, Dom Flemons, and others, this film reaches beyond John’s musical impact on society and explores his humanity through family relationships. A Man Called Hurt illustrates the importance of John Hurt’s legacy and cultural preservation through emotional interviews, stunning cinematography, and archival footage. title: 15th Annual Arlington Jazz Festival
description: Featuring the Stanley Jordan Trio with Wes Wirth and Kenwood Dennard SEAT PRICES Premium: $65.00 Preferred: $47.50 Reserved: $30.00 In a career that took flight in 1985 with commercial and critical acclaim, guitar virtuoso Stanley Jordan has consistently displayed a chameleonic musical persona of openness, imagination, versatility and maverick daring. Be it bold reinventions of classical masterpieces or soulful explorations through pop-rock hits, to blazing straight ahead jazz forays and ultramodern improvisational works-solo or with a group-Jordan can always be counted on to take listeners on breathless journeys into the unexpected. Key to Jordan’s fast-track acclaim was his mastery of a special technique on the guitar’s fretboard. Instead of conventional strumming and picking, Jordan’s innovative “touch technique” is an advanced form of two-handed tapping. While a handful of other players were using similar techniques, Stanley’s fluid, multi-layered textures and sheer virtuosity raised the bar for excellence. But his technique, though impressive, is always a means to a musical end. His music is imbued with a warmth and sensitivity that has captured the imagination of listeners worldwide. A classically trained pianist before playing guitar, Jordan wanted greater freedom in voicing chords on his guitar, so he applied piano principles to do so. Jordan’s touch technique allows the guitarist to play melody and chords simultaneously with an unprecedented level of independence. It also allows Jordan to play simultaneously on two different guitars, or even on guitar and piano. He says that “I think of it as a single instrument, but one with a wide range of tonal colors-that’s why I do it.”

description: Hooray! The Three Cats are back! A new, bright, exciting, and incredibly fun show has been prepared for you by your favorite characters from the “Three Cats” animated series: Korzhik, Karamelka, and Kompot. “Three Cats” is a new, captivating performance in which all the characters from the cartoon will appear on stage in beautiful, realistic costumes. Unforgettable adventures await them, which they will share with our young viewers. An exciting plot, many beloved songs, hilarious jokes, tricks, magic, and a great mood from “Three Cats”! April 16th in Boston! Come join us, meow-meow-meow! Embarking on an exciting adventure, the kittens must overcome many difficult challenges, demonstrate resourcefulness, kindness, and honesty, outsmart the cunning Rat once again, and most importantly — they prove that they are true friends and are ready to help each other at any moment. In the finale of the play, the kittens will surely find the treasure and realize that friendship and family are the most important things in the whole world! Tickets: $45 – $65

Listen to testimonies, analyze evidence, and ultimately decide… guilty or not guilty? 🫣 Crime #1: Superstar Lana Tonneti’s $20m necklace is gone. Now her ex-driver’s on trial for the theft. But is there more to the story? Scandal brews as a disgraced ex-driver stands trial for stealing global superstar Lana Tonneti’s $20m necklace. But is Lana telling the truth? And at the end, you must cast the vote that determines the fate of the accused. Will justice be served? Well, that’s up to you. title: No Static Plays the Music of Steely Dan
description: Commemorating the 50th Anniversary of The Royal Scam album. The 10 members of No Static have performed the music of Steely Dan since 2005. Thousands of Dan lovers young and old have experienced the excitement they bring to every performance. Appearing at first-tier venues across New England and beyond, this talented band has earned the admiration and affection of critics and fans alike. Based in Boston, No Static is one of the top Steely Dan tribute bands in the country. These dedicated musicians specialize in expertly performing the music of Steely Dan, re-creating that amazing bluesy jazz-rock sound invented by Donald Fagen and Walter Becker. As Dan fans know, this is no small feat. The music is complex, spanning genres, requiring precise attention to musical detail, with subtle grooves, sophisticated vocal harmonies, iconic solos, and time and key changes popping up when least expected. Steely Dan is not an easy band to pay tribute to. SEAT PRICES Premium: $55 Preferred: $45 Reserved: $40

title: Spacewoman
description: A film by Hannah Berryman Astronaut Eileen Collins was the first woman to pilot and command an American spacecraft. Born on the other side of the tracks in upstate New York, she smashed many glass ceilings in the US Air Force and at NASA during her career, culminating in four increasingly dramatic and dangerous space shuttle missions. With an incredible set of archival materials, intimate interviews, and a moving score by Marcelo Zarvos, Hannah Berryman’s nail-biting film shares the emotional journey experienced by Eileen’s family, and asks the philosophical question about what level of risk is acceptable in human endeavour. ﻿ film runtime: 1h35m Tickets General Admission: $20 Seniors (62+): $18 Veterans: $1

title: Roger McGuinn
description: Mr. Tambourine Man not only lived history, he made history with his fearless sense of experimentation. As the leader of the influential 60s group, The Byrds, he was on the leading edge, combining the rock beat of the Beatles with the folk sensibilities of Bob Dylan, to create the genre known as “folk-rock.” His groundbreaking work on The Byrds “Sweetheart Of The Rodeo” album, is widely credited with ushering in the genre of country rock. Roger’s solo career began in 1973 and has yielded 13 albums, a Grammy nomination, and extensive touring and performing for enthralled audiences ever since. Tickets go on sale Friday, January 30 at 10am

title: An Evening with Joe Avati
description: Internationally renowned for inimitable style Avati, who is Australian born with an Italian heritage, is one of the most significant and pivotal comedians of his generation who, undoubtedly, is directly responsible for the ethnic comedy circuit around the world today. For the past 30 years Joe Avati’s routines about growing up with a culturally diverse background have gained him a cult following around the globe. Avati has also become the master of treading the very fine line of saying whatever everyone seems to think but no one dares to say whilst not resorting to the use of profanities or vulgar shock tactic routines and in doing so allowing audiences of all ages to attend his shows. He has a razor sharp wit and his observations are not only deadly accurate but extremely relatable to his growing international audiences. Joe Avati is, without doubt, one of the world’s most loved and successful comedians of his generation. In 2024 Joe Avati won the ACE AWARDS Comedian Of the Year and completed a 282 date world tour spanning two years with his award winning show WHEN I WAS YOUR AGE!!! title: Another Tequila Sunrise
description: ANOTHER TEQUILA SUNRISE is America’s premier Tribute to the Eagles. Since 2001, this New England based tribute band has been delighting sell-out crowds across the country with a catalog of music that encompasses the classics and deep cuts from the Eagles’ studio collection, as well as the biggest hits from the solo careers of Glenn Frey, Don Henley, and Joe Walsh. And they do this with an unparalleled commitment to the music. Another Tequila Sunrise has gone beyond the realm of understanding “how” this music was made. Yes, their ability to recreate these iconic studio sounds does not go unnoticed; but what really sets them apart is their ability to recreate the Eagles’ LIVE experience. And to do that, one must understand not only “how” the music was made, but also “why”. Why does Henley alter his drumming pattern ever-so-slightly? Why does Felder choose this particular lick or passage over another? Uncovering these notions is crucial to peeling back the layers of these timeless songs, the key to improvising like an Eagle, and the secret to delivering a painstakingly authentic Eagles LIVE experience…..and this all-star lineup has it in spades. ﻿ SEAT PRICES PREMIUM: $54 PREFERRED: $44 RESERVED: $34 “All-included” price, no added fees. Senior and veteran discounts available. Member discounts apply, please contact the Box Office. General Information and Policies
